spec.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT c.*, cr.called_month_n, cr.returned_month_n, cr.returned_month_pct, cr.return_open_n,
  np.too_few AS np_too_few, np.new_patients_n, np.new_returned_n, np.new_loss_pct,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'new_patients' AND key = 'min_patients') AS np_min, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'called_below_pct') AS called_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_below_pct') AS early_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_days') AS early_days, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'return_days') AS return_days, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'min_overdue_phone') AS min_overdue_phone
FROM report_calling('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) c
LEFT JOIN report_calling_return('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) cr ON cr.org_unit_id = c.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN report_new_patients('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) np ON np.org_unit_id = c.org_unit_id
WHERE c.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT cr.called_month_n, cr.returned_month_n, cr.returned_early_pct, cr.returned_later_pct, cr.return_open_n, c.early_n,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_days') AS early_days
FROM report_calling_return('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) cr
JOIN report_calling('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) c ON c.org_unit_id = cr.org_unit_id
WHERE cr.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

spec.description: Patients first called in the month who visited within 30 days of that call. Early calls are within 14 days of becoming overdue.
spec.title: Came back within 30 days, by when we called

spec.rawSql:
SELECT c.*,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM report_calling('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) f WHERE NOT f.is_selected AND f.level >= (SELECT level FROM hierarchy_config WHERE var_name = 'facility')) AS facilities_n
FROM report_calling('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) c
WHERE c.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT org_unit_id, json_agg(json_build_object('report', report, 'flag_reason', flag_reason, 'patients_n', patients_n)
           ORDER BY report)::text AS flags_json
  FROM report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) GROUP BY org_unit_id
)
SELECT c.*, cr.called_month_n, cr.returned_month_n, cr.returned_month_pct,
  np.flag AS phone_flag, np.new_patients_n, np.new_usable_phone_n, np.new_usable_phone_pct,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'called_below_pct') AS called_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_below_pct') AS early_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_days') AS early_days, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'return_days') AS return_days, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'min_overdue_phone') AS min_overdue_phone,
  fl.flags_json
FROM report_calling('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) c
LEFT JOIN report_calling_return('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) cr ON cr.org_unit_id = c.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN report_new_patients('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) np ON np.org_unit_id = c.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.org_unit_id = c.org_unit_id
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_days') AS early_days,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'return_days') AS return_days
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'
